operations.title: Triangle-wall ambient-16 K5 quotient-line audit packet
Test the canonical triangle-wall quotient line at the first source-derived joint target (16,5)
The canonical triangle-wall quotient line survives the first source-derived joint pole-degree step while its distinguished coordinate vanishes
Nima reports invariant survival at the derived ambient-16 K5 target
operations.body: The strict source census derives (A,K)=(13,4)->(16,5): 27,580 requested labels; ambient 13 misses 240 labels of degrees 18-20; ambient 16 is first complete. Lossless embedding preserves 1,228/1,228 terms. At the ambient-16/K5 target, individual probes 6 and 19 vanish, but the invariant Entry-1063 quotient line survives: graph-zero image rank 7, augmented image rank 8, quotient image rank 1. Its normalized representative is rewritten to 36 block-zero terms, with no block-one or block-two term. Cache write/replay agree exactly. Thus loss of the distinguished degree-14 coordinate is a basis rewrite, not death of the class. No direct-limit or physical conclusion.
